constraints.meaning: The array is never empty and has at most 10,000 elements.
constraints.impact: O(n²) is about 10⁸ steps: slow and risky. One pass, O(n), is the safe target. No empty-array check is needed, but the code still works for n = 0.
Values fit in int in C and C++. Only 0 is special: negative numbers are non-zero and must keep their order too.

constraints.meaning: You may not build a second array.
constraints.impact: O(1) extra space. This rules out 'copy the non-zeros, then pad with zeros' and points to two pointers inside one array.

constraints.text: Keep the relative order of the non-zero elements (statement)
constraints.impact: Swapping from both ends would break the order, so both pointers must move in the same direction.

bruteForce.summary: move each non-zero left past the zeros, like bubble sort: O(n²) time, O(1) space. Copying the non-zeros into a new array is O(n) time, but it needs O(n) extra space, which breaks the in-place rule.
